2. Concept of Ensemble Learning

Ensemble learning is based on the principle that combining the predictions of multiple models can result
in better
performance than any individual model. There are three main types of ensemble methods:
Bagging (Bootstrap Aggregating) – e.g., Random Forest
Boosting – e.g., AdaBoost, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost
Stacking – combining predictions of different model types

AdaBoost
falls under the Boosting category, where weak learners are trained sequentially, and each new learner
focuses more on the mistakes made by the previous ones.
3. Idea Behind AdaBoost
